conviction_note: Near-zero: an upward revision at H1 is more likely than not (Q1 operating profit +23%, the April securities gain landed 90m yen above its stated 477m), but kabutan has twice put the name at the top of its public upward-revision list on a 65.9% ordinary-profit progress rate that is mostly a gain already inside the May guide, and last year's H1 upward revision (ordinary +8%) was sold -1.78% over the window; p_up 47 on an abs move of 2.0 gives -0.12, against a findings sum of -0.05, and the two agree that there is no edge here.
bar: Company FY3/2027 plan, ordinary profit 1,350m yen (operating 620m, net 950m), unchanged at Q1 (2026-07-24 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260723598662.pdf). No analyst consensus exists: kabuyoho shows コンセンサス '--' (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=2804). The bar is a company plan, not a street number, so sizes are capped small. print_vs_bar is my estimate of the implied full-year ordinary profit (about 1,430-1,470m) against the 1,350m plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 1.48% across 2 sellers as of 2026-10-22, change -0.01pt (flat, neither building nor covering) (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 0.65 (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=2804, 2026-10-23), so margin shorts exceed margin longs, but this is a 優待-heavy name with March/September record dates, so part of the margin short is likely benefit-cross residue rather than a squeeze setup. No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct +1.0, almost all of it the short_squeeze component. run_up_20d -0.11%, run_up_5d -1.17%: no visible run-in on the revision lists.

findings.finding: The headline Q1 ordinary-profit progress of 65.9% (890m of 1,350m), which put 2804 first on kabutan's public upward-revision lists of 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-22, is mostly a ~477m investment-securities gain that the company announced on 2026-04-02 before it set the May guide; the underlying operating progress is 24.8% (154m of 620m). That still points to a modest revision (actual gain 567m, about 90m above the stated 477m, and operating profit +23%), likely ordinary about +5-10%, smaller than the 65.9% headline implies to the retail readers of those lists.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same setup last year: 2025-10-24 15:00 H1 release with ordinary revised up 8.3% and operating up 20% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251023/140120251023577876.pdf): opened +2.5% and closed -0.15%, then -1.78% by the next close. At the 2025-07-25 Q1 upward revision (ordinary +20%) it rose +4.09%, then +8.7% over two days. At 2026-01-23 (Q3, operating progress 86%) it closed +0.47%, then -1.6% by the next close (Yahoo daily bars https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2804.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The April notice is public, but the list readers have the 65.9% headline (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2804&b=n202610221276, 2026-10-22, ranked first by progress against a 5-year average of 24.5%). The stock has not run up (20d -0.11%), so the expectation may be held as an option on a revision rather than paid for. If the market fully believed a large revision it would have risen into the print, and if it fully discounted the gain the list would not lead with it. Partly priced either way, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 non-operating line: 投資有価証券売却益 567m vs 167m a year earlier, and 業績予想に変更なし (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260723598662.pdf). This is a second document that bears on the same revision question, merged here rather than filed twice.

findings.finding: The 2026-08-21 capital-cost update lists 長期保有株主向けの優待制度の検討 (considering a benefit programme for long-term holders) as an open action item. A 株主優待 change at the H1 batch is possible on a retail-heavy register; the company expanded 優待 at its 2026-01-23 Q3 release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-23: 株主優待制度の拡充 announced with Q3 at 15:00 (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260123/140120260122537206/). Closed +0.47% that day and -1.6% by the next close, so the last 優待 expansion did not hold.
findings.why_not_priced: It is listed as under consideration, with no date, so the market cannot price whether it lands at this print. If it were expected now, the name would show a run-in, and it shows none. The probability that it lands today is low, so the size is small.

findings.finding: The buyback frame (660,000 shares, 1.2bn yen, to 2027-03-19) had 435,700 shares bought by 2026-09-30, leaving about 224,000 shares to buy in the market, roughly 6 days of the name's ~19k-share daily volume. The frame stays a supporting bid through the window, though it is already public.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-24 frame expansion with Q1 (16:30), plus a ToSTNeT-3 purchase on 07-27: +0.66% then +1.59% cumulative (Yahoo daily bars). That was new information; this one is not.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, since the frame and the monthly status reports are public. What is left is mechanical support against post-print selling in a thin name, so the size is near zero.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: likely modest and upward. Last year's company revised at both Q1 and H1, and this year's 65.9% ordinary progress is mostly a gain that sits inside the guide. Returns: the 1.2bn-yen buyback frame runs to March 2027 and the 45-yen dividend is already raised, so a new return is unlikely; a 優待 change for long-term holders is possible. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: operating 24.8% at Q1 against 20% last year (125/613), slightly ahead.
baseline_tension: The priced lean is +1.0 (short_squeeze from a 0.65 margin ratio) and the run-up is flat. My evidence is close to neutral and leans very slightly the other way, on a sell-the-revision reaction history. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward revision plus a 優待 change. I looked for both: the revision is likely but modest and mostly anticipated by the public lists, and the 優待 change is undated. So I am not short against the lean in any meaningful size.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public progress-rate data moves p_up toward 50): the guidance finding's negative tilt rests on the public April notice and the public Q1 短信, so I moved p_up from 45 to 47 and the finding from -0.3 to -0.2.

Rule 2 (check the sign; name the strongest positive): baseline_tension now names the revision, the 優待 change and the buyback, all of which I searched. The draft's buyback size was trimmed from +0.1 to +0.05 as fully public, which is a 3a size change and does not touch p_up.
Sum moved from -0.05 to 0.0 and expected_move from -0.20 to -0.12.
